title: Review of c03's gated FCH micelles (SIBWD): replicates on seed 17, but an ungated twin with uniformly lowered cargo D holds the cargo as well (W not beyond diffusion)
summary: Re-ran the claimed world unchanged on seed 17 (T=400): ~29 micelles from white noise, 24 persistent splits, generation 3, 0 merges; the shell q forms a membrane-like ring (rim/core 9.9, rim/outside 5.0, 242/248 individuals) and 99.4% of body-frames hold the self-made cargo at >= 2x (aggregate 25-34x after t=200). Daughters keep their own ring and >= 2x cargo, though fission visibly spills cargo into streaks between them. As a diffusion control I ran an ungated twin (beta=0) with the cargo diffusivity lowered uniformly to 0.0055, the gate's value at the mid-run ring q: on the same seed it forms the same bodies and holds cargo in 99.9% of body-frames at 16-2000x. Because the cargo is made inside the bodies, slow diffusion alone retains it; the gate is one way to make it slow, not a containment a Laplacian-only twin cannot match.

observations.S: rerun/seed17/sheet.png t=0: white noise over the whole domain; ~29 micelles by t=16
observations.I: rerun/seed17/sheet.png t=16-400: discrete round micelles, 33 persistent tracks (FACTS.md)
observations.B: rerun/seed17/FACTS.md radial: shell q rim/core 9.86, rim/outside 4.98, 242/248 individuals membrane-like
observations.W: contrast.txt: 99.4% of 4004 body-frames >= 2x, aggregate 25-34x after t=200; the claim's pack_beta0 is the gate ablation (1.1x)
observations.D: rerun/seed17/lineage.png: 24 persistent splits, max generation 3, 0 merges; sheet t=104 and t=244-280 show dumbbells splitting into two ringed daughters

seeds_run.result: lowered-D ungated twin also holds cargo (99.9% >= 2x)

controls_run.W: rerun_lowD/seed17 (world_lowD.py: beta=0, Dc=0.0055 uniform): cargo held at least as well as with the gate; the W gate ablation itself is the claim's pack_beta0 (Dc=1, 1.1x)

verdicts.limitation: The matched Laplacian-only twin (no gate, cargo D lowered everywhere to the gate's mid-run ring value 0.0055) retains the self-made cargo as well as the gated world (contrast.txt), so W here passes the rubric's ablation gate (beta=0 at Dc=1) but is not beyond diffusion: with a cargo made inside the body, any slow diffusivity holds it. A W that a lowered-D twin cannot match needs a cargo supplied from outside or made outside (c01's uptake world is one). Fission leaks cargo into streaks between daughters (sheet t=260-400). Shell and cargo are passive; division is the fed micelles' own. I did not re-run the 1.5x resolution control.
